node.title: XR rank-five base residual has a multiplicity-sensitive rich-line hierarchy
node.statement: In the P-A RowC rank-five u=v=0 branch, put b=C(4+h,4), T=C(R+4,4), and B=8n^3. For every r>=2 with d_r=b-floor((r-1)T/(B+1))>0, any family above B has a nonempty subfamily in which every member lies on at least d_r distinct collision lines containing at least r members. The exact minimum degrees at r=3 are 123/120/27, and positive forced cores persist through r=74/40/9 at rates 1/4,1/8,1/16. This is a structural rich-line reduction, not a count of the surviving core.
